karonta.cp: pr.p of karoti. doing; acting; making; building.
karonta.p: [Kara+o+anta] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī karontī] One who is doing (or) doer. (1) One who is speaking (or) speaker. One who urges to do (or) One who makes causing. (3) One who instructs.

B:
karonta： karonta（ti）
ကရောန္တ（တိ）
[kara+o+anta．thī-nitea karontī]
[ကရ+ဩ+အန္တ။ ထီ-၌ ကရောန္တီ]
C: karonta：[pr．p of karoti] doing； acting； making； building．
